title: Amber advisory for severe lightning issued for several provinces
byline: The Meteorology Department has issued a severe lightning advisory, warning of thundershowers accompanied by intense lightning activity in several parts of the country today (3).

title: Gazette issued on VAT amendments effective from July 1
byline: The Gazette notification outlining amendments to the Value Added Tax (VAT), scheduled to take effect from July 1, has been issued by the Ministry of Financial Planning and Economic Development.

title: Signs of increase in school transport fees due to fuel price hike
byline: School transport fees are likely to increase in the near future following the latest revision in fuel prices, the All Island School Transport Professionals Association said.

title: Mahinda Rajapaksa, Piyankara Jayaratne summoned to Bribery commission
byline: Former President Mahinda Rajapaksa and former Minister Piyankara Jayaratne have been summoned to appear before the Commission to Investigate Allegations of Bribery or Corruption (CIABOC) on May 12, 2026.

title: Russian Health Minister Mikhail Murashko arrives in Sri Lanka
byline: The Health Minister of the Russian Federation, Mikhail Murashko, accompanied by a high-level delegation, arrived in Sri Lanka this morning for a three-day official visit. The delegation landed at the Bandaranaike International Airport (BIA) in Katunayake at 10:20 AM via Aeroflot flight SU-288, arriving directly from Moscow.

title: Over 120 foreign nationals arrested in Rajagiriya
byline: The police have arrested at least 120 foreign nationals during a raid at a location on Meda Welikada Road in Rajagiriya. The group was taken into custody following reports of their involvement in large-scale illegal financial transactions and other illicit operations conducted within the country.

title: Oil tanker hijacked off coast of Yemen and taken towards Somalia
byline: Somali pirates have hijacked an oil tanker off the coast of Yemen, according to multiple Somali security officials that spoke with the BBC.

title: OPEC+ members meet to set new oil quotas following UAE’s exit
byline: Seven members of OPEC+ will meet today to decide on oil production levels for the first time since the UAE left the group.

title: Maldives President Muizzu arrives in Sri Lanka today
byline: Maldives President Mohamed Muizzu is scheduled to arrive in Sri Lanka today (May 3) on a state visit, marking his first official trip to the country since assuming office in 2023.

title: IRIS Dena sinking: Survivors testimony, diplomatic delays, and US-India-Sri Lanka role
byline: The new evidence comes from Commander Abuzar Zarri, captain of the Dena, and the vessel’s first officer, who appeared in an Iranian television report released on April 21. Zarri, who had previously been reported dead, appeared injured and using a crutch.

title: Air India cuts international flights till July amid jet fuel price hike, closure of certain airspace
byline: Air India is all set to cut its international flights till July because of a surge in jet fuel prices and the ongoing airspace restrictions that made several routes unprofitable, said the firm’s Chief Executive Officer (CEO) and Managing Director (MD) Campbell Wilson on Friday.

title: Corruption of past rulers wasted resource-rich nation: PM
byline: Prime Minister Harini Amarasuriya said that Sri Lanka, despite being a country rich in resources, had been severely undermined due to corruption by past rulers.

title: 37 foreign nationals arrested in Talangama cybercrime raid
byline: A total of 37 foreign nationals, including a woman, have been arrested on suspicion of involvement in computer-related crimes following a raid in Talangama.

title: LIOC increases fuel prices following CPC revision
byline: Following the fuel price hike by the Ceylon Petroleum Corporation effective from midnight yesterday (02), the Lanka Indian Oil Company has also announced an increase in selected fuel prices.

title: Fuel prices increased from midnight
byline: Fuel prices will be increased with effect from midnight today, the Ceylon Petroleum Corporation (Ceypetco) announced.

title: War with US ’likely’ to restart after Trump rejects proposal, Iranian official says
byline: Trump said on Friday that he was ’’not satisfied’’ with Iran’s latest proposal, without detailing which elements he opposes, while the White House refused to comment on the state of the negotiations.

title: US bypasses congressional review for military sales of $8.6 billion to Middle East allies
byline: BBC - U.S. President Donald Trump’s administration has bypassed congressional review to approve military ‌sales totaling over $8.6 billion to Middle Eastern allies Israel, Qatar, Kuwait and the United Arab Emirates.

title: Qatar Airways resumes operations to Iraq
byline: Doha, Qatar: Qatar Airways continues to reinstate its network across the Middle East, announcing the return of passenger flights to Baghdad (BGW), Basra (BSR), and Erbil (EBL) in Iraq, starting on May 10, 2026.

title: Mahindananda Foundation returns leased property to Railways Department
byline: The Mahindananda Aluthgamage Foundation has returned a property it occupied for nearly 20 years to the Department of Railways.

title: Sri Lanka to tour West Indies for multi-format series in June-July
byline: Sri Lanka Cricket has announced that the Sri Lanka men’s national cricket team will tour the West Indies cricket team in June and July 2026 for a full bilateral series.

title: Range Rover shifts gears with boutique residency
byline: Range Rover has taken its luxury playbook off the road and into Colombo’s high-end real estate, with Access Motors unveiling a boutique residency at ITC Rathnadeepa Colombo One Workplaces.

title: Alleged pre-Easter attack warning messages surface
byline: Sri Lankan activist Oshala Herath has released a series of screenshots purportedly showing WhatsApp exchanges between the Director of the State Intelligence Service (SIS) and the Defence Ministry Secretary, allegedly warning of a possible terrorist attack prior to April 21, 2019.

title: Shooting reported at Galle Prison following escape attempt
byline: A shooting incident was reported at the Galle Prison today, following a daring escape attempt by two inmates.

title: Vehicle prices set to rise from May 1 on SSCL hike
byline: Imported vehicle prices in Sri Lanka are expected to increase from May 1 following a 2.5% hike in the Social Security Contribution Levy (SSCL) and the continued appreciation of the US dollar.

title: Mittal family set to own 75% of Rajasthan Royals in $1.65 billion deal
byline: The Mittal Family has reached a definitive agreement to acquire a controlling stake in IPL franchise Rajasthan Royals in partnership with Adar Poonawalla. The deal, signed with current owner Manoj Badale and his consortium, values the franchise and its associated teams at about $1.65 billion.

title: Suspect shot while attempting to escape Police custody
byline: Police opened fire on a suspect today (May 3) after he attempted to escape while being prepared for transport to the Galgamuwa Magistrate’s Court.

title: Maldivian President Mohamed Muizzu arrives in Sri Lanka
byline: Maldivian President Mohamed Muizzu arrived at the Bandaranaike International Airport (BIA) this afternoon, marking the commencement of a high-profile state visit to Sri Lanka.

title: Sajith’s speech at May Day rally - People left as it was late: MP
byline: Referring to the report that people who were at the Samagi Jana Balawegaya (SJB) May Day rally walked out when Party Leader Sajith Premadasa began his speech, MP Harshana Rajakaruna said today that the people left the ground as it was late in the evening.

title: Mahinda Rajapaksa has not received CIABOC notice: Spokesman
byline: Former President Mahinda Rajapaksa has not received any official notice from the Commission to Investigate Allegations of Bribery or Corruption (CIABOC) regarding the controversial Airbus transaction, his media spokesman said.

title: Iran war: Trump reviewing new Tehran proposal with doubt
byline: Donald Trump said on Saturday he was going to review a new peace proposal from Tehran but cast doubt over its prospects, saying Iran had not yet “paid a big enough price”.

title: Iran presses for end to war with US within 30 days
byline: Iran’s latest 14-point proposal calls for issues between it and the US to be resolved within 30 days and aims to end the war rather than extend the ceasefire.
